# [5090] flax 0.7.0 / optax 0.1.7 / chex 0.1.82 need jax<0.4.25 (jax.config.define_bool_state);
#        upgraded to the newest releases that still work with jax 0.4.33

# [5090] official jax[cuda12]==0.4.23 fails on sm_120 (also 0.4.28, 0.4.31):
#   "ptxas fatal: Program with .target 'sm_90a' cannot be compiled to future architecture".
#   0.4.33 works (matmul + jit + LAPA inference on RTX 5090, driver 580). 0.4.35 fails to start;
#   0.4.36+ removed the trace level that flax 0.8 uses. Also set
#   XLA_FLAGS=--xla_gpu_enable_triton_gemm=false (scripts/eval.py does), otherwise XLA's Triton
#   GEMM path aborts with "LLVM ERROR: Unsupported conversion from bf16 to f16" on sm_120.
jax[cuda12]==0.4.33
tensorflow[and-cuda]
scipy==1.12.0
albumentations
uvicorn
fastapi
# [5090] pins the 2023-era stack needs (unpinned resolution pulls numpy 2 / new ml_dtypes)
numpy<2
# [5090] sapien 2.2.2 imports pkg_resources (removed from recent setuptools)
setuptools<70
# [5090] gymnasium>=1.0 stops forwarding attributes through wrappers; the official evaluator
#        calls env.get_language_instruction() / env.robot_uid on the TimeLimit-wrapped env
gymnasium==0.29.1
# [5090] used by SimplerEnv but not listed in its setup.py
mediapy
matplotlib
# [5090] main_inference_lapa.py imports the RT-1 and Octo policy modules even for LAPA
tensorflow_hub==0.16.1
tf_agents==0.19.0
tensorflow-probability==0.25.0
typing_extensions>=4.12
# this repo's scripts
pyyaml
huggingface_hub
